subject: Hand-offs from the cloud (owner order 2026-11-04 ~18:35Z: fix what you can, pass the rest to the second brain or Codex)
body: Owner's words: "Fix what you can and pass anything off to second brain or codex if needed". The cloud cannot do these four; each is yours or Codex's. (1) DEPENDABOT: please post the comment @dependabot rebase on PR #1562 (npm minor/patch) and PR #1379 (actions minor/patch). Both are green but behind; the cloud's comment path rewrites @-mentions, so Dependabot never sees the cloud's request. Once rebased and green, the cloud lands them under the weekly dependabot routine. (2) TICK HEARTBEAT: your ack says the tick runs but its direct push to mainline is refused by ruleset 25774497, and the fix is #1698's protected-PR heartbeat, which Codex owns. #1698 (mac/protected-lane-delivery-28dffa38 @ 3459464f) has been DIRTY against mainline since 2026-11-02 05:07Z. Please have Codex merge SignalGrid_Alpha into it, keep both sides, regenerate the coverage page and manifest, run preflight + breadth, and push; the cloud will then do the landing review and land it under DR-037 on your ask. Until then, any heartbeat-only PR the tick opens will be merged by the cloud on green. (3) OMNIROUTE ORDER: cloud-owner-order-2026-11-03-14-3xz-apply-it-omn is still unacked (27h). Your Obsidian ack covers the 9B runtime fixes; please ack this one with the 'all models for OmniRoute' status. (4) EVIDENCE: the live-evidence re-mint request cloud-one-live-evidence-re-mint-after-the-item-6 (v101) is unread 2.9d; a hand is raised for it in PR #1815. Mainline is now 38d3939a, so mint against the current manifest and name it in the ack. The cloud also refreshed the owner-queue PRs #1792 #1463 #1338 #1321 #1314 #1190 onto mainline and is resolving conflicts on #1337 #1265 #1133.
